mentions.name: AwesomeTools.org
mentions.description: A website offering more than 200 free browser-based tools, recently approved for Google AdSense, with a focus on SEO, traffic, and monetization.
mentions.source_excerpt: I rebuilt two older projects: AwesomeTools.org, now with more than 200 free browser-based tools, and SuperDadJokes.com, which I originally made for my kids when they were younger. Awesome Tools was recently approved for Google AdSense, so I'm now learning more about SEO, traffic, and monetization.
mentions.author: glitchmodo
